svg.title: Platform: one host, four layers
svg.desc: From the top: 61 services in three groups (home automation, media, operations); the cluster platform delivered by Argo CD (MetalLB, Traefik, CrowdSec, Authentik, cert-manager, Sealed Secrets, Falco, Proxmox CSI, NFS provisioner, PostgreSQL, Redis); six Proxmox guests (K3s control plane VM 200, K3s workers VM 201 and 202 with iGPU virtual functions, TrueNAS VM 100, the CI runner VM 300 and the Debian template VM 900); and the hardware of a single tower. Backups replicate to a USB pool and go off-site with restic.
svg.text: CLUSTER PLATFORM · ARGO CD PLUS 15 INFRASTRUCTURE APPS
PROXMOX VE · SIX GUESTS, THREE OF THEM K3S NODES
Volumes replicate to an encrypted USB pool; restic sends them off-site every night; healthchecks.io watches each run.
